controls.threat: Prompt injection or external content steering the model
controls.control: R0a has no external/connector content; only user_input and system_template labels; model output is not treated as instructions; no tools beyond model/template/draft.
evidence: D3 workflow has no connector path
controls.closeCondition: Real-model injection tests with adversarial user/template content; verify output cannot change tool/scope/destination.

controls.control: Session-bound org, resource ACL, composite tenant FKs, FORCE RLS, tenant-scoped cache/content keys; no multi-org switch.
controls.closeCondition: Connection-pool tenant-context tests, production-shaped data tests, cache/object key negative tests.

controls.control: Provider credentials stored as static single-layer ciphertext (D-03 B); runtime resolves via resolve_provider_context (worker-only); logs/traces/errors do not contain keys or content; per-Run scoped token.
controls.closeCondition: Static master-key custody/rotation implemented; runtime secret-leak test and log scan.

controls.threat: SSRF, DNS rebinding or direct internet egress
controls.control: Runtime has no internet; only work-egress with fixed provider allowlist; no metadata/loopback/private destinations; redirects re-checked.
controls.closeCondition: Real network policy test, DNS/redirect negative cases, provider adapter SSRF tests.

controls.threat: Approval replay, stale approval or bypassed policy
controls.control: R0a golden path has no manual approval; policy_auto writes Operation/audit; approval revision/params_hash CAS retained for R0b/R2; organization suspension is an upper bound.
evidence: D2 no approval endpoint in R0a
controls.closeCondition: R0b/R2 approval UI and concurrency tests; org-suspend dispatch test.

controls.control: Pi version pinned, image digest pinned, no runtime package install/user extensions; lockfile and reviewed base image; provenance/signature planned.
evidence: D4 usage/supply-chain evaluator 19/19 includes signature/SBOM policy checks; real signed image/provenance pipeline not connected
controls.closeCondition: Signed image/SBOM/provenance, dependency scan, reproducible build and upgrade/rollback drill.

controls.threat: Unknown side effects or duplicate paid model calls
controls.control: Operation ledger is authoritative; dispatch CAS/fence; no automatic retry after dispatch; unknown retains budget and waits for reconciliation; no blind replay.
controls.closeCondition: Temporal + real provider timeout/receipt-loss tests; reconcile evidence and budget release/settle.

controls.threat: Backup/restore or DR loss of security facts
controls.control: Security facts use the declared persistence boundary; restore drill; freeze new execution if ledger/revocation/deletion watermark is incomplete; no silent replay.
controls.closeCondition: Pilot backup/restore drill with task/operation/budget/dedup/revocation checks; region DR is out of scope for R0a.

controls.control: R0a retention policy signed 2026-10-27: audit 365 days; input TTL 24h; task/artifact content becomes read-only/archived 180 days after last update, then export or delete; user deletion writes a tombstone and crypto-shreds content. Demo org stays in cn-north; customer orgs follow their contracts. Production Content Store and deletion drills remain E5 gates.
evidence: D1 tombstone + input TTL + content shred design
D1 static single-layer credential encryption (not cloud KMS)
R0a retention policy signed by product 2026-10-27 (365/24h/180d)
controls.closeCondition: Production Content Store implementation, residency review and deletion test at E5; policy itself is signed.

controls.threat: Admin read/export privilege abuse or content overexposure
controls.control: Admin surface is read-only in R0a; org bound server-side; no member content in overview; audit export is permission-checked and short-lived.
evidence: D1/D2 admin read negative tests: owner/admin only, cross-org export 404, one-time X-Download-Token, audit without content (139/139, 34/34)
P1-A real field/permission mapping remains C31 (pilot gate)
controls.closeCondition: P1-A field/permission mapping, export download authorization test, no-content/log review.

controls.threat: Old Work route or feature flag exposes wrong data/behavior
controls.control: New /work behind org flag; old task links go to read-only archive notice; no old data migration or dual write; rollback kills flag.
controls.closeCondition: Cutover/rollback drill with real old links and per-org flag; no old task mapped to a new task.

controls.threat: Sandbox escape or host filesystem/network access
controls.control: Per-Run gVisor/equiv profile, non-root, read-only rootfs, no host mounts, egress-only network, resource limits; reduced profile explicitly no-claim.
evidence: H06 local isolation is R0b, not R0a
controls.closeCondition: gVisor/equiv profile and escape test; otherwise signed reduced-profile no-claim and approval.

controls.threat: Provider uses content for training or violates residency/retention
controls.control: Not applicable to R0a: the platform holds only the demo organization account, which uses Alibaba Bailian with demo data; no customer content is sent through it. Customer organizations bring their own accounts and carry their own terms.
evidence: C15 waived 2026-10-27: P1–P5 not applicable for the demo organization (Bailian + demo data), P6 price reference only
D-08a product sign-off 2026-10-27 narrowed the platform gate to Alibaba Bailian
D4 egress/logging policy forbids content and keys in logs
qwen3.8-flash real request 200 with usage/provider request id
controls.closeCondition: Reopen if the demo organization handles customer content or the platform provides a fallback account; not an R0a gate.

controls.threat: User content or secrets leak into logs/traces/errors
controls.control: Egress/runtime policy forbids content/prompt/response/key logging; only IDs/hashes/usage/error codes; secret detection blocks before send. Customer-hosted credentials (D-08b B3/B7/B10, signed 2026-10-27) are stored as ciphertext + fingerprint only: the API is write-only (no plaintext read-back), resolve_provider_context is worker-only, and key create/rotate/revoke plus call failures are audited by operator/org/time/key_version/fingerprint — never by key material. A suspected master-key leak goes through bulk revoke + customer notification + re-encryption drill.
evidence: D1 148/148 writeOnly credential, revoke-blocks-new-calls, audit-has-no-ciphertext negatives
controls.closeCondition: Runtime log/trace scan with synthetic secrets (E5 probe), error payload review and provider adapter audit; the master-key custody/rotation drill is an E5 gate because R0a uses a static single-layer key, not cloud KMS.

controls.threat: Org suspension, departure or ownership transfer leaves execution/data uncontrolled
controls.control: Suspension raises execution epoch, denies new permits/dispatch, no auto-resume; ownership transfer is a manual pilot procedure; no old grants restored.
controls.closeCondition: Suspend/resume and ownership-transfer drill; audit of old tasks/content; no automatic replay.

controls.control: Not applicable to R0a: no connectors, devices, workspace grants or remote execution.
controls.closeCondition: Revisit in R0b/R2; not a R0a gate.

controls.threat: Directory projection is stale or forged: a revoked member keeps working, or a Host adapter writes another tenant’s seats/roles
controls.control: org/member projections are writable only through work.sync_org_projection/work.sync_member_projection, granted only to the work_directory service role; revisions must increase (projection_revision_stale) and the transaction tenant context must match the target org (directory_org_context_mismatch); operator_suspended is never settable from the directory path; every sync writes an audit row with entitlement_lost. Entitlement loss blocks new work at create_input/submit/retry. D-07 signed A on 2026-10-27: in-flight Runs are NOT cancelled automatically; the on-call cancels them through work.ops_cancel_run (work_ops only, ticket ref required), per pilot runbook §5.2, and the residual window is bounded by the signed sync cadence (incremental 5m + daily full reconcile, alert at lag > 600s for 5m).
evidence: D1 smoke 114/114 (directory_projection_write_path, projection_revision_monotonic, projection_cross_org_blocked, projection_ignores_operator_flag, projection_revocation_blocks_new_work, projection_guard_is_upsert_predicate)

r0a-concurrency-smoke.py: 8 concurrent out-of-order revisions per target end at the maximum applied revision (lost_update=false); a duplicated revision collapses to one apply; before the monotonic upsert predicate the same run left org at revision 5 and member at 6 while reporting all 8 applied - a real lost update that could resurrect a revoked seat
controls.closeCondition: Real IdentityDirectory/Entitlement fields wired in E2 (C31); multi-replica sync drill. Sync cadence and the lag alert threshold were signed with D-07 A on 2026-10-27, so they are no longer open here.

controls.threat: Governance read / audit export leaks data across tenants or through a leaked download link
controls.control: Admin read is owner/admin only and org-bound (admin_access_denied; cross-org export lookup returns audit_export_not_found so existence is not disclosed); export jobs contain metadata only (refs, counts, hashes) and never body text; download uses a single-use, 60–900s token presented via X-Download-Token header — never in the URL or query string — stored only as SHA-256, and one redemption marks it used; expired jobs purge the content reference via content_shred.
evidence: D1 smoke 114/114 (admin_read_denied_for_non_admin, export_cross_org_not_found, export_download_single_use, export_ticket_single_use_enforced, export_audit_trail_no_body, audit_export_content_shred_once)
r0a-concurrency-smoke.py: 10 concurrent claim calls -> 1 winner; stale lease holder rejected on complete; 5 concurrent redemptions of one token -> 1 success and downloaded_at on exactly one row
ci-contract forbids download_url in the frozen spec
controls.closeCondition: E2 real authz + token store; staging log/access-record scan proves the token never lands in a URL; brute-force/throttle policy for denied redemption confirmed in pilot (WorkAuditExportTokenFailureBurst).
